childNodes.textContent: The only line Glass needs. data-replay-sample-rate="1" records every session (for the demo).

attributes._cssText: body { font: 16px / 1.5 system-ui; max-width: 640px; margin: 40px auto; padding: 0px 20px; }a, button { font: inherit; }button { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(153, 153, 153); background: white; cursor: pointer; }nav a { margin-right: 12px; }

:root { color-scheme: light; }body { font: 16px / 1.6 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: rgb(29, 42, 38); max-width: none; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; background: rgb(251, 250, 247); }nav { display: flex; gap: 22px; align-items: center; padding: 16px 40px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(231, 227, 218); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }nav::before { content: "Inkwell"; font-weight: 700; margin-right: auto; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }nav a { color: rgb(74, 90, 84); text-decoration: none; margin: 0px; }h1 { font-size: 40px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 56px 40px 12px; }p, form, ol { margin-left: 40px; margin-right: 40px; max-width: 640px; }button, .cta a { background: rgb(29, 42, 38); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 0px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }input { border: 1px solid rgb(214, 209, 198); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font: inherit; min-width: 260px; }li { padding: 6px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(239, 235, 227); }
